text:
maria: quick heads-up — I ran a small sweep combining SmoothQuant + activation-aware (SQ+AA) with FP8 fallback and AWQ on the new 48k long-context trace from the docs pipeline. initial numbers look... interesting. :thinking_face:
kevin: nice, which model and quant stacks?
dana: ping me the run id, I want the accuracy deltas and the p99 latency.
maria: model=redwood-open-7b-v2, variants: (1) fp32 baseline, (2) AWQ-INT8, (3) SQ+AA-FP8, (4) hybrid: SQ+AA + AWQ int8 fallback. run id=2312345678-sweepA.
kevin: got it. what infra? GPUs / batch / kvcache shape?
maria: single A100-80GB, batch_size=1 (latency profile), kv cache enabled for 48k tokens, kv-eviction disabled for this run. trace is mixed conversational + code.
dana: paste quick metrics pls — top-line accuracy (perplexity delta / em-like pass rate) and p50/p95/p99 latency.
maria: short dump: ````
baseline fp32: ppl=12.4, pass@1=0.72, p50=0.23s, p95=0.48s, p99=0.82s
AWQ-INT8: ppl=13.1 (+5.6%), pass@1=0.70 (-2.8%), p50=0.18s, p95=0.35s, p99=0.62s
SQ+AA-FP8: ppl=12.6 (+1.6%), pass@1=0.715 (-0.7%), p50=0.17s, p95=0.34s, p99=0.60s
hybrid (sq+aa w/awq fallback): ppl=12.8 (+3.2%), pass@1=0.705 (-2.1%), p50=0.18s, p95=0.36s, p99=0.63s
````
kevin: latency win is solid. p99 difference ~0.2s vs baseline. that's promising for serving. Did you observe degenerative failures for long prompts?
maria: interestingly, SQ+AA had two misformatted JSON responses on long code cells (out of 1.2k eval cases). AWQ had three. baseline had none. The errors are subtle truncation + tokenization chop at high positions.
dana: can you share an example failure (prompt + generated) for inspection?
maria: snippet: ````
PROMPT: <system> Keep code intact</system>
... 
GEN (SQ+AA): "def foo():
    print(\"start\")
    for i in range(10):
        ..."
(missing closing paren on deep loop)
````
Seems like token alignment drift near 44k-47k.
kevin: could be kv-cache float->quant rounding accumulation. Any difference when forcing kv-cache to fp32?
maria: I re-ran two traces with kv cache forced to fp32 for SQ+AA and AWQ hybrid. Results: ppl delta shrank by ~0.2 for both and the two misformats disappeared on SQ+AA run. p99 increased by ~0.04s.
dana: that suggests activation rounding in cached keys is the likely culprit. Good catch. For deployment we can: (A) enable fp32 kv-cache for >32k sessions, (B) keep hybrid fallback to AWQ, (C) introduce a periodic kv reflush for very long sessions. Thoughts?
kevin: (A) is simplest but costs memory. (B) is already in hybrid. (C) may add latency spikes but could be throttled during idle tokens. I'd prefer A+B for now.
maria: agree. Also ran eval with small temperature shifts — errors concentrated at low temp (0.0-0.2) -> more hallucinated truncation vs sampling noise.
dana: can we add a quick automated check to the onboarding pipeline: after quantization, run 200 long-context golden prompts and fail if any structural parse errors (JSON/paren mismatches) appear?
maria: I already added a smoke test locally. I'll open a PR to infra bench harness to add it as gating.
kevin: please include an opt-out flag for small deployments.
maria: will do. filing follow-ups: #1 PR with kv-cache opt flag and smokecheck, #2 doc note on memory tradeoffs for fp32 kv cache, #3 longer sweep for 96k if we turn on fp32 kv (to estimate mem pressure).
dana: thanks. last ask: save the full run artifacts (log + kv snapshots) to s3://redwood-ml/quant-sweeps/2312345678 and tag me. bench-bot: upload complete (2312345678-sweepA) :white_check_mark:
bench-bot: artifacts: s3://redwood-ml/quant-sweeps/2312345678/2312345678-sweepA.tar.gz
kevin: perfect. can we schedule a short sync tomorrow to decide RF for rollout? 10am PT?
dana: 10am PT works for me. maria: works. :thumbsup:
